title: Draft product labelling and instructions-for-use
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Requirements rely on labels for ride ratings, module requirements, retirement and no-use cases (REQ-H3, H4, H6, D3). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Draft the on-product labels (text, symbols, placement) and the instructions-for-use outline for each product, marked as DRAFT templates.
acceptanceCriteria: Every label requirement in requirements.md is covered
Uses ISO 7010-style symbol references by number only
Includes the water-ride and structural-failure limitations
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
